## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does Scandit cost?

Pricing depends on your goals and the scale of your deployment, such as the number of devices, scans, or stores. Share a few details, and we’ll send you a tailored quote today.

### How much does Scandit cost per device?

If you choose usage-based pricing by device, the cost per device varies based on your volume and commitment.

### Is Scandit billing monthly or yearly?

Our standard billing frequency is yearly, but in certain situations can accommodate any special requests.

### Does Scandit offer a pay-as-you-go model?

Our subscription can be tailored to your needs, starting with a small upfront commitment that scales as you grow. For flexible, scalable options, billing based on scans is an ideal choice.

### Does Scandit offer a one-time payment option?

Our standard pricing is an annual subscription model based on the scale of your deployment and the features you choose.

### What customer support does Scandit offer?

Dedicated solution consultants, support engineers, and post-sales customer success. Scandit support has a satisfaction rate of >96%.

### Can I get indicative pricing from Scandit to support early-stage planning?

Absolutely! We are happy to help you build your business case.

### What factors affect Scandit pricing?

Scandit pricing is based on the capabilities you need (Core, Standard or Advanced Edition) together with the scale of your deployment.
